patterns.note: An immersive, continuous background animation transitions from an ocean surface to a deep-sea environment as the user scrolls, revealing new content sections.
Full-bleed background imagery anchors vertically stacked, full-screen content sections, each featuring centered, large-scale typography.
Key phrases within sans-serif headings are highlighted using an elegant, flowing script font, creating a distinctive artistic and editorial feel.
A gradient of blues, transitioning from warm sunset tones to deep, dark ocean hues, forms the primary background palette, with white text providing high contrast.
The page unfolds as a long-scrolling narrative, with each major content block presented in a distinct full-screen section, visually differentiated by the evolving background.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated background animation system, likely utilizing a video hero and GSAP ScrollTrigger, to create an immersive visual journey. As the user scrolls, the full-screen background seamlessly transitions from an ocean surface to a deep-sea environment, with elements like text and subtle graphic lines appearing and fading in sync with the scroll depth. The initial navigation remains sticky but eventually gives way to a full-screen footer.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with elegant script accents, complemented by smaller, legible body text and tiny uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy hero, generous vertical spacing throughout, creating a sense of depth and allowing background visuals to breathe.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the immersive, continuous background animation that visually transforms from an ocean surface to a deep-sea environment as the user scrolls, creating a powerful metaphor for 'diving deeper' into the company's offerings. This dynamic visual storytelling is highly engaging and memorable.
